newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Sinophil up at record high of 2.3 centavos.
newsitem.headline: Sinophil up at record high of 2.3 centavos.

text.p: Sinophil Corp rose by 0.1 centavo to a record high of 2.30 centavos by late session on talks that it would be the real estate arm of its parent Belle Corp, brokers said.
Sinophil was the most actively traded stock in the bourse on Wednesday with turnover of more than 156 million shares.
"We heard that Belle will transfer its real estate activities to Sinophil ... It means that Sinophil will have some assets to its name," Ramon Borja, analyst of Dharmala Securities, said.
Belle will concentrate on its gaming interests. Belle was unchanged at 7.40 pesos.
Company officials were not immediately available to comment.
